artworks.title: Cardinal de Bouillon
artworks.medium: engraving on heavy laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 29.7 x 19.9 cm (11 11/16 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a bust of a man from the chest upwards. The man is facing slightly to the right with a neutral expression. He has medium-length wavy hair, prominent eyes, and is dressed in formal attire with a large, collared garment and an ornate medal hanging from his neck. A coat of arms is engraved on the pedestal of the bust. The background is plain with no additional elements, focusing solely on the figure.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: drypoint in blue-black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body in an etching style. The man has a confident expression, prominent cheekbones, a mustache, and piercing eyes. He wears a stylish hat with a wide brim and a dark band, a formal suit, and a patterned bow tie with prominent dots. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Le Pont-au-Change, Paris
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The cityscape in the image includes a river, a large architectural structure on the right, a stone bridge stretching across the scene, pedestrians and a horse-drawn carriage crossing the bridge, a hot air balloon in the sky, and a small boat on the water. The scene is depicted in an etching style, using fine lines and detailing with a monochromatic sepia color palette conveying a historic ambiance. Smoke rises from chimneys in the distance as the city extends into the background.

artworks.title: Aldenham Church, Hertfordshire
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with black chalk and white heightening on blue wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 23.8 x 31.3 cm (9 3/8 x 12 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a churchyard, showcasing a stone building with a slanted roof leading to a square tower extending upwards. The horizon is partially obstructed by the structure and trees. Some gothic-style windows are visible on the building. There are gravestones scattered nearby. The brushstrokes provide texture to the stone walls and foliage. The color palette is subdued with shades of gray and sepia. In the distance to the right, a figure walks with a dog along a path.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This painting depicts a pastoral landscape viewed from an elevated angle, showing rolling hills extending into the distance. Sheep graze on a hill closest to us, while trees on the left and right burst with pink and white blossoms. In the distance, a person with a dog walks up the slope toward us and the sheep. The color palette consists of pastel greens, pinks, and blues, while some of the grass is light yellow. The sky beyond the hills is mostly filled with white clouds, with small areas of blue peeking through.

artworks.title: Summer
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This painting shows a curving countryside path on the left, with a wooden fence partially visible on the far left in front of a cluster of green trees. The path is cutting through a field of yellow grass with bright red flowers on the right. A woman stands on the edge of the path, to the left of center. She is looking towards the trees on the left. She wears a gray dress with a white apron and appears to hold a basket. Closer to us, to the right of center, a child stands among tall yellow grasses, holding a bunch of bright red flowers. The child is facing the left, looking towards the woman. They wear a blue dress with dark stockings and have shoulder-length, reddish-brown hair. Both people have pale skin and no visible facial features. In the distance there are rolling blue hills beneath a pale gray sky. The brushstrokes in the painting are fluid, and some colors blend together.

artworks.title: Autumn
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This painting shows a colorful landscape with a curving path leading across a hill and into the distance. Distant hills fade into a soft blue hue near the horizon. The path is lined with colorful vegetation in shades of orange, red, gold, light green, brown, and lavender. A dark-green and brown hill slopes up on the left, while the right contains a few tall trees. A person with a large, yellow pack walks away from us on the path, heading around the curve of the hill. The sky above is light gray with streaks of white and patches of pale blue.

artworks.title: Winter
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This painting depicts a snowy landscape. The horizon is in the center of the painting, showing a cream and light gray sky meeting rolling white and light blue hills. Small, snow-covered buildings in shades of pale red and yellow and what may be a church tower are visible at the base of the hills, next to thin, leafless gray trees.  The color palette includes white, blues, and earth tones. Closer to us, near the center of the painting, a person in a brown coat and hat carries a bundle of sticks through the snow. Around them are a line of deep footprints. They are facing the left, towards more tall gray trees and a wooden fence.

artworks.title: Bamberg
artworks.medium: lithograph touched with white gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view of architectural details and activity in a historical town setting. The scene is focused on buildings, street life, and a group of people near a building corner. The buildings feature ornate windows, balconies, and textured facades with fine linework and shading. The illustration style is precise with delicate brushstrokes or sketch lines. The color palette is monochrome using black and white. In the distance, people walk on a cobbled pathway, surrounded by trees, with a figure rowing a boat on a waterway. Birds are visible in the sky.

artworks.title: Zwinger Palace, Dresden
artworks.medium: lithograph touched with white gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image displays an architectural drawing of Zwinger Palace in Dresden. The drawing shows a terrace with balustrades and two figures leaning on it. The palace features baroque spires and intricate details. The color scheme is primarily sepia, emphasizing the detailed linework and shadows.

artworks.title: Chateau de Martinsbourg, Mayence
artworks.medium: lithograph touched with white gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows an intricately designed building from what appears to be the Renaissance or Baroque period. The building is viewed from a lower angle, emphasizing its grandeur and elaborate architecture. Two church towers with onion-shaped domes are visible on the horizon against a clouded sky. The artwork demonstrates precise technique with fine lines and shading, possibly etching or engraving. The color palette is monochromatic, using different shades of brown for an aged aesthetic. In the foreground, there are covered stalls and people interacting with goods on the ground with a mix of stone and grass. An enclosed area with arches leads to the church towers. The composition conveys a sense of historical grandeur and everyday activity.

artworks.title: French Street Scene with a Medieval Turret
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a street with a building prominently featured on the right side. The scene depicts a busy street with people engaged in daily activities. The architecture in the image is intricate and detailed, with a color palette of earthy tones and subtle pops of red and blue. The scene conveys a bustling street market atmosphere with figures carrying baskets and tending to market stalls.

artworks.title: Laundresses before the Wasserturm, Nuremberg
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from the water's edge of an old village with medieval buildings, a stone tower, and a calm body of water. Four individuals are near the water engaged in various activities. The painting style suggests a watercolor technique with light washes creating a soft and detailed atmosphere. The color palette consists of muted earth tones and soft blues.

artworks.title: Cattle
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several bovines. The sketch depicts a group of cattle, featuring adult cows and possibly a calf, loosely arranged in a horizontal line. The lines of the drawing are light and sketchy. The animals are depicted in side profile, with simplified details, capturing their basic form and movement. The overall tone of the drawing is soft and understated.

artworks.title: Antique Figure
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown watercolor and gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing and looking up. The individual is in a kneeling or slightly crouched position with their hands clasped in front of their chest. They have long hair, wearing a flowing garment. The background is blank. A monogram "T.R." is in the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Tree Study
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with blue-gray and gray washes over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image is a watercolor painting depicting a woodland scene. The viewpoint is at eye level, offering a view of a forest. A birch tree is prominently featured on the left side of the composition. The painting uses soft brushstrokes to depict the tree trunk and a subtle color palette to create an ethereal atmosphere. The landscape extends into the distance, with hints of trees and foliage in a misty background.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a man from the shoulders up. He is slightly turned to his left but looking ahead. The man has a full beard and mustache, and wears a textured hat that obscures most of his hair. He appears to be wearing a jacket over a collared shirt. The background is minimal with sketch-like lines and shading. The man is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects.

artworks.title: View of an Estate
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a viewpoint with a building surrounded by greenery in a valley. In the distance, there are hills under a cloudy sky. A stream flows through the terrain, with figures crossing a bridge. Sheep are scattered across the landscape. The painting uses soft brushstrokes to depict natural elements and structures with a harmonious color palette of earth tones, greens, and blues.

artworks.title: View of an Estate
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with rolling hills, a river, trees, and a building in the distance. The sky has light clouds and the colors are soft greens, browns, and light blue. The hills add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Tally Llyn from Llyn Trigrain
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil sketch of a mountainous landscape. The perspective appears to be from an elevated point, possibly on a hillside overlooking a valley. The horizon line is low, emphasizing the peaks and slopes in the distance. The mountains and valleys are defined with expressive pencil strokes and subtle shading. The monochromatic color palette consists of various shades of gray. Near the viewer, there are outlines of boulders and small figures, leading the eye towards a valley pathway. In the background, there are rolling hills and distant mountain ranges.

artworks.title: Isle de la Cite, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape from an elevated point of view overlooking a river. The flowing water is depicted with etched lines. Buildings cluster densely in the city with details like windows and structures. The lines vary, with fine details for buildings and loose strokes for the sky and river. The color palette is monochromatic, using the natural tone of the paper and dark ink for contrast and depth. A pedestrian bridge spans the river, with small figures on it and along the pathway below. The bridges connect the bustling area near us with the urban expanse beyond.

artworks.title: River Landscape with a Castle
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a river flowing towards a distant castle on a rocky hill. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, likely from a hillside or cliff. The landscape features gentle slopes, trees, and a serene river with figures in a boat. The color palette is subdued, with browns, greens, and soft blues dominating the scene.

artworks.title: Monte Circeo at Sunset
artworks.medium: watercolor on paper; laid down on original presentation mount
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image is a landscape viewed from an elevated angle. The horizon is visible in the distance, with mountains meeting the sky. The sun is present behind a dominant mountain mass. The brushstrokes create a smooth texture blending the elements, including the sky and clouds that cover much of the upper part of the image. The color palette includes earthy tones in the foreground, transitioning to grays and blues in the water and mountains, and pale blues and creams in the sky. In the lower right, there is a curving path with a small group of figures walking towards the landscape. The overall atmosphere is tranquil and serene.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river flowing across it. The horizon line is in the middle, with distant hills and a few structures aligning with it. Large trees are on the left side with textured brushstrokes. Soft, flowing strokes are used with a monochromatic grey color palette. In the distance, there is a hazy background with subtle tones creating a sense of depth and tranquility.
